description: Type-safe mock data generator for Zod v4 schemas. Generates deterministic, seedable mock data from Zod schema definitions, with CLI, config file, and MCP server support.
rules: Requires Zod v4.0.0+. For Zod v4.0.0-v4.3.4 use zod-v4-mocks v2.1.0+. For Zod v3.25.76 (v4 preview) use the separate zod-v4-preview-mocks package.
The entry point is initGenerator(config). Call .generate(schema) to produce a single mock, or .generateMany(schema, count) / .factory(schema) for many.
Pass a fixed `seed` to initGenerator for deterministic output across runs. Inside custom generators use options.faker instead of Math.random()/Date.now() to preserve determinism.

Customize values with .supply(ZodType, value) (all nodes of a type), .supplyRef(schemaNode, value) (one specific node by reference), .supplyPath(path, value) (by structural path, with $item/$value wildcards), or .override(customGenerator).
z.custom() and z.instanceof() must define meta({ mock: ... }) or be targeted with supplyRef; otherwise the slot is dropped from arrays/objects.
A shared zod-v4-mocks.config.{ts,js,mjs} file (via defineMockConfig) is auto-discovered by the CLI and loadConfig(), exposing base/cli/test profiles.
An MCP server is available via `npx zod-v4-mocks mcp` (stdio), exposing usage, list_schemas, preflight, and generate_mock tools; schemas are referenced by compiled .js/.mjs file path.
